reader.requirement: At --std 85, when an OCCURS ... DEPENDING ON data-name-1 entry is subordinate to an entry carrying GLOBAL (a GLOBAL 01 record, or a record of an FD written GLOBAL), the compiler must refuse a data-name-1 that is not a global name, and refuse one that resolves to an item described in a containing program's Data Division rather than this program's own.

COBOL2788 has no per-edition arm.
